title: DENEVIL: TOWARDS DECIPHERING AND NAVIGATING THE ETHICAL VALUES OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA INSTRUCTION LEARNING
reasoning: The entire paper is focused on evaluating and aligning the ethical values of LLMs. It uses the Moral Foundations Theory as a framework to construct a high-quality dataset (MoralPrompt) covering over 500 value principles, specifically to benchmark and improve the moral alignment of various models.
